entities.name: Festival of Tales
entities.description: Annual story-sharing gathering in Kinsbaile in 4520 AR, attacked by the elven packs of Nath.

entities.name: Kinsbaile
entities.description: Kithkin clachan on Lorwyn where the festival was held.

entities.name: Colfenor
entities.description: Last red yew, honored guest and storyteller who burned away saving Ashling.

entities.name: Nath
entities.description: Taercenn of the Gilt-Leaf whose packs attacked the festival; killed by Rhys.

entities.name: Brion Stoutarm
entities.description: Shot with poisoned arrows at the festival.

entities.name: Kiel
entities.description: Brion's brother, shot with poisoned arrows.

entities.name: Rhys
entities.description: Outcast kithkin hero lured to the festival who killed Nath.

entities.name: Sygg
entities.description: Carried Rhys's party away on the Wanderwine River.

entities.name: Gaddock Teeg
entities.description: Cenn of Kinsbaile, subdued by the elves and killed by the conflagration.

entities.name: Brigid Baeli
entities.description: Kithkin hero ordered to abduct Ashling and lure Rhys.

entities.name: Ashling
entities.description: Flamekin doused and knocked unconscious, later reignited by a greater elemental.

entities.name: Gryffid
entities.description: Rhys's former friend who swore vengeance.

events.summary: Nath's hunting packs attack the festival, shooting Brion and Kiel with poisoned arrows.
events.quote: they shot Brion Stoutarm and his brother Kiel full of arrows

events.summary: Sygg carries Rhys's party away on the Wanderwine River.
events.quote: The latter were only saved by the quick actions of Sygg

events.summary: The elves subdue Gaddock Teeg and Colfenor sends a forged message to Brigid.
events.quote: Colfenor sent a forged message to Brigid Baeli

events.summary: Brigid fights Ashling in the Murmuring Bosk and lies to Rhys.
events.quote: the kithkin hero lied to Rhys that Ashling had gone mad

events.summary: Rhys duels Nath in the Kinswood and breaks his neck; both are revealed as eyeblights.
events.quote: Rhys proved the superior combatant and broke Nath's neck
his former friend Gryffid swore vengeance over him

events.summary: A greater elemental reignites Ashling, costing Colfenor and Teeg their lives.
events.quote: This came at the cost of both Colfenor's and Cenn Teeg's lives

events.summary: Brigid and Rhys join forces to rescue Ashling.
events.quote: Brigid and Rhys decided to join forces

relations.note: Broke his neck in a duel

relations.quote: Brigid and Rhys decided to join forces
